brief:
Education in Gaza continues operating despite widespread infrastructure damage from the conflict, according to Maan Wire. Schools across the territory have adapted to severe conditions, including damaged buildings and limited resources, while attempting to maintain teaching and learning activities for students.

The resilience of Gaza's education system reflects efforts by teachers and administrators to sustain schooling despite the humanitarian challenges facing the territory. Educational institutions have implemented alternative arrangements to keep classrooms functioning amid the devastation.
title: Gaza's schools resist destruction amid ongoing conflict
